archetypes.name: workdir-recovery
archetypes.rationale: Workdir resolution spans env, git, and keepalive fallback tiers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Codex review workdir resolver. Check that each fallback tier is ordered correctly, validates git roots, and does not regress local plugin development or stale keepalive behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retry-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Retry loop budget accounting is ordering-sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the auth retry loop changes. Focus on whether the unclassified empty exit-1 bonus attempt is exactly one extra launch, runs before auth-budget exhaustion, and cannot mask explicit auth or quota failures. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
